rows.text: receives a Rs 19.40 cr purchase order from Hindustan Power Exchange for hardware, software and licences, 60-day execution
receives a **Rs 1.33 cr** work order from **IIT Kanpur** for supply and installation of smart server racks, to be executed within 60 days
receives a **Rs 2.56 crore work order from Banaras Locomotive Works** to upgrade its RailNet network, over nine months

receives a **Rs 1,78,00,000 work order from Northern Railway, Lucknow** to augment and upgrade last-mile connectivity of the coach maintenance system at stations across the Lucknow division, within 180 days.

**Rs 1.43 cr work order from Hindustan Aeronautics** for an IT-network upgrade (~5.1% of mcap; SME) — the RSS subject was a contentless "Kindly take this in your record"; the filing itself is a real HAL order.
This is to inform that company has received the order worth INR 261.86 lakhs from Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad. (Rs 2.62 cr)
